LESSON: TIME

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: MATHEMATICAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.4: Time
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Time, part of Measurement in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three MATHEMATICAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: what each division represents. ● Learners discuss 1. How do we read and tell time using digital and analogue clocks?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Time together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: learner discusses how to tell time on the clock face using “past” and “to” the

hour.

● Learning to learn: learner reads and tells time on analogue and digital clocks.

Values:
● Respect: learner accommodates diverse opinions as they discuss the importance of keeping time in real life situations.

● Peace: learner displays tolerance as they in turns read and tell time on a digital clock.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Social cohesion: learner takes turn in activities and conversations as they read and tell time on analog and digital clocks.

Link to other learning areas:

● The learner is able to relate the skills used in drawing the clock face to drawing skills in Creative Activities.

Learning resources:

Clock face, tactile clock face, manilla paper, digital talking clock.
